item.title: MySQL Setup
item.description: This guide uses MySQL 8.4 LTS and two native Speedle processes: PMS writes policies, and ADS reads the same database with a separate read-only account. item.title: etcd Setup
item.description: This walkthrough uses an external etcd v3.6.14 server with a persistent Docker volume. PMS writes policies and ADS watches the same key prefix. The single-node example listens on loopback and uses plain HTTP for local development. Production TLS and cluster configuration follow the walkthrough. 1. item.title: MongoDB Setup
item.description: This walkthrough uses MongoDB 7.0.16 as a single-node replica set with a persistent Docker volume. PMS writes policies and ADS follows the same database through a change stream. The example listens on loopback without authentication for local development. Production authentication, TLS and replica set configuration follow the walkthrough. MongoDB must run as a replica set or sharded cluster. ADS watches the database with a change stream, and replacing the whole policy store runs in a transaction; a standalone mongod supports neither.
